includes: Lessons include instruction in horsemanship, grooming, equipment, and riding skills.
Helmets available for all riders if they do not have their own.
Group packages include hands-on experience with horses and age-appropriate games on horseback.
Apprenticeship includes group and private riding lessons, mentoring, and participation in horse shows and clinics.
gap: Age minimum not stated for birthday parties or group lessons.
blurb: Guests can take private or group horseback riding lessons, participate in birthday parties or scout troop activities involving riding and horse care, and join apprenticeship programs for advanced horsemanship. Camps are offered seasonally for ages 5-16, including summer and school year sessions. The ranch teaches both English and Western riding styles and emphasizes horsemanship skills and equestrian practice.
